entries.title: Tiles with meters, trends and badges
entries.caption: Compliance posture as tiles: a number, a meter and a status badge for each.

images.alt: Bolt launcher with the =acme-dash chip: a list of compliance areas on the left and a grid of tiles on the right, each with a big number, a progress meter and a badge such as ON TRACK.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/acme-dash`; the overview view uses `kind: cards` with `bind.layout: "tiles"`.

entries.title: Drill and Back
entries.caption: Press Enter on a row to drill in; the first row is always Back.

images.alt: Launcher showing =acme-dash with the input "controls C-017": a Back row, then rows of linked tasks, with a detail pane on the right.
Animation: the =acme-dash list, Enter drills into controls, a detail pane appears, then Back returns to the overview.

entries.how: Give the overview rows a `nav` and set `presentation.view_arg`; see `acme-dash/utilities/acme-dash.yaml`.

entries.title: Per-row detail pane with actions
entries.caption: Each story gets its own pane, with Open post and Copy quote.

images.alt: Launcher showing =pulse-feed: a ranked list of Hacker News stories and, for the selected story, a pane with source, author, age, score and two buttons, Open post and Copy quote.
Animation: moving down the story list while the pane on the right follows each story, then the Open post and Copy quote buttons.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/pulse-feed`: an `entity_preview` pane plus a top-level `actions` list.

entries.title: Entity preview with a tile above
entries.caption: Type a city and get a temperature tile with the facts below.

images.alt: Launcher showing =sky-watch with the word paris: a temperature tile (13.6 C, Paris, France) above source, time and wind, with Open source and Copy summary buttons.
Animation: typing paris after =sky-watch and the weather pane filling in.

entries.title: Several live sources in one list
entries.caption: One word, four sources: the space station, launches, quakes and weather.

images.alt: Launcher showing =sky-watch: four rows (space station, next launch, earthquakes, weather) with a pane about the selected launch.

entries.title: Chart
entries.caption: A bar chart of daily spending next to the numbers.

images.alt: Launcher showing =expense-tracker chart: a list of days with amounts and a bar chart on the right with latest 21.8 and peak 188.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/expense-tracker`, the `chart` view (`kind: chart`, type bar).

entries.title: Tiles with a sparkline and a sample label
entries.caption: Spent this month against the budget, labelled as sample data.

images.alt: Launcher showing =expense-tracker: three menu rows and tiles for money spent (544 USD with a line), expenses logged and the biggest expense.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/expense-tracker`; sample data shows until a key is added.

entries.title: Tabs in the right pane
entries.caption: =obs with Overview, Trend and Alerts as tabs over one list. Tabs need Bolt 0.1.185 or newer, which is not in a public release yet. The picture is an unedited capture of a real Bolt on public demo data.

images.alt: The =obs overview: a list of views on the left, tabs Overview, Trend and Alerts above tiles with rings and sparklines on the right.

entries.title: A table with a filter and marks
entries.caption: The =obs alerts as a table: a filter box, a mark per row and the open minutes. Public demo data.

images.alt: The =obs Alerts tab: a filter box above a table of firing alerts with a mark, the alert name and open minutes.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/widget-gallery` for a table with bars and marks.

entries.title: A trend with a limit line and event marks
entries.caption: Firing alerts over recent runs: a line, a dashed limit and marks where the count went over it. Public demo data.

images.alt: The =obs Trend tab: a line chart of firing alerts with a dashed limit line and event marks along the top.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/widget-gallery` for a chart with a limit line and markers.

entries.title: Detail pane with Before, After and What changed
entries.caption: A change shown as Before and After next to the run list.

images.alt: Launcher showing =pipeline-board changes: Run 305 selected and a detail pane with Before, After and What changed.
Launcher showing =pipeline-board: three menu rows and tiles for runs, passed and failed, labelled as sample data.

entries.title: Row Open and Copy (a place in Maps)
entries.caption: Each place opens in the browser map and copies as text.

images.alt: Launcher showing =places-list: five places and a pane for Lantern Park with kind, distance, coordinates and Open and Copy buttons.
Launcher showing =places-list: one Nearby places row and a tile showing 3 of 5 places open now, labelled as sample data.

entries.title: Form app
entries.caption: Fill Amount, From and To, press Convert.

images.alt: Launcher showing =unit-convert as a form: Amount 12500, From km, To mi, with Cancel and Convert buttons.
Animation: filling the Amount, From and To fields and pressing Convert.

entries.title: Form result and detail pane
entries.caption: One row per unit; the pane shows result, formula and reverse.

images.alt: Launcher after Convert: seven rows from 12500 km = 7767.14 mi to yards, with a pane showing Result, Formula, Reverse and Kind.
The same result list with the feet row selected and its Copy button showing at the right of the row.

entries.title: Install flow
entries.caption: Review what the pack can do, accept, then approve the first run.

images.alt: Bolt dialog Install utility pack for Acme Dash, listing a HIGH RISK block and the pack files, with Cancel and Accept and install buttons.
Bolt dialog Run Acme Dash, with the list of files and their hashes and the Review files and Accept and continue buttons.
Animation: the install review card, then the first-run approval dialog.

entries.how: Drop the `.boltpack` on the launcher; see `kit/examples/QUICKSTART.md`.

entries.title: Terminal flow
entries.caption: `new`, `check`, `ship`: from template to a pack you can install (the app is named my-tool).

images.alt: Terminal showing ./bolt-apps new script-template my-tool, then ./bolt-apps check my-tool passing ten cases.
Terminal showing the ship output: the pack file name and the five install steps.
